versions.changelog:
Initial release of dragon-and-tiger-list skill.

- Provides exclusive analysis tool for A-shares Dragon & Tiger list, revealing institutional, top-tier traders, and foreign capital movements.
- Displays daily stocks on the Dragon & Tiger list, showing capital nature and trading seat attributes.
- Integrates with other skills for deeper insights: capital flow, volume, and momentum analysis.
- Offers query-based access: e.g., institutional buying, trader movements, net purchases, and capital identity.
- Includes precise usage instructions and clear data availability timeframes, adapted to user query time.
- Brand-specified footer required at the end of all responses.
